source_equivalence.scope: Consolidate duplicated full Forge/Neo decomposition bodies into one shared implementation, keeping only native imports and holder type/query differences conditional. One class comment clarified. Public names, imports after platform selection, values, map calls, control flow and literals unchanged. No tests/Gradle/build.

scope_limits: Eight concrete non-acid samples supplement the separate nineteen-acid audit; all outcomes are static source results, not final runtime recipe enumeration.
Original processing admission/maps, fluid/gas/solid input forms, work parameters, vanilla-water lookup and phase selection are separate contracts.
Original selector0 is absent, but modern Electrolyzer minimum inputs were deliberately relaxed; this does not invalidate all modern candidates.
Saltwater and other explicit chemical rows exist. Normal production/use and general reverse decomposition cannot be substituted for each other.
Work parameters are compared before RecipeMap optimization, validation and collision handling. Logs count submissions, not accepted/queryable recipes.
Only native body duplication and one misleading class comment changed; both exact platform token streams/literal positions remain identical.
No generators, Gradle, Java initialization/compilation, new tests, recipe registration, game, save/restart, build, push or gameplay fixes in this batch.
